scope: Separate completed upstream video tasks from verified account-owned media retrieval; preserve original task IDs and explicit retrieval-only retries

local.productionBuild: passed after removing invalid local Turbopack cache from build inputs

browserAPI.presets: OpenAI added without overwriting existing channel
browserAPI.perModelParameters: declared choices enforced; custom resolution and literal ratio retained
browserAPI.mockSubmit: two intercepted requests: legacy and inherited shared rule; exact prompt/ratio/resolution/duration/model
browserAPI.errorDetails: full sanitized diagnostic retained in existing details dialog; no automatic create retry

browserCatalog.catalog: admin import/edit/export/delete; ordinary user selects without importing
browserCatalog.discovery: manual file found without restart; deleted file disappears
browserCatalog.credentials: user key not in catalog; existing account unchanged after deletion
browserCatalog.modelDiscovery: existing selector; search/multiple/all/clear; candidates opt in; cancel/failure/late response preserve configuration; temporary key absent from writes and export; no generation
browserCatalog.privateStorage: local type remains stable across tabs and save
browserCatalog.fieldOmission: typed values edited, copied to shared rules, saved, exported and synced to account channel

browserRetrieval.refresh: fetching and ready restored without duplicate retrieval
browserRetrieval.metadata: response held; successful canvas persisted before metadata

cases: Complete, slow, interrupted and mismatched-length streams (including declared zero)
Actual HTTP disconnect and fixture-only deadline retain stage, byte count and request ID
Missing MP4 index rejected before media indexing; HTML rejected
Local atomic rename and S3/WebDAV file streaming
Owner isolation, 12 concurrent initial requests and 12 explicit same-attempt retries produce one transfer per attempt
Failed retrieval does not auto-retry; successful refresh reuses one media record
Stale generation updates cannot replace completed tasks; completed tasks survive old cleanup interval
Browser with indefinitely pending media response persists and restores the ready canvas without metadata
Database backup: additive V1 migration twice, interrupted recovery and existing task data preservation

dependencyReview.assessment: The three raw module matches affect goldmark, rsc.io/pdf and golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp; none of those packages is in this target dependency graph. Original API records and exact dependency graph are retained. Final image scan remains a separate CI gate.

migration: migrateVideoRetrievalV1 creates video_retrievals only; interrupted attempts become failed on startup; existing accounts, channels, keys, canvas, media and task columns unchanged
retentionChange: Completed task records remain until explicit deletion so retrieval can resume; no numeric resource, retry or HTTP timeout settings changed
rollback: Previous pinned image can read existing tables with the additive table present; preserve data and original encryption key. Previous download defect remains in that image.
limitations: Production evidence file was not accessible; diagnosis uses the operator-provided excerpt and source review
Original production transport error and exact browser wait were not captured
MP4 validation checks transport and top-level container structure, not complete codec decoding
Single API process; multi-replica delivery recovery is not supported
Historical truncated media are not automatically removed; recovery needs a retained original task
Initial server retrieval begins when a client observes completion and posts the retrieval request; after acceptance it does not require an active page
resolvedLocalFailures: Existing browser preset click was unstable; test now uses keyboard selection and verifies the selected option, without changing UI or skipping assertions
Repeated production build hit invalid persistent cache; clean-cache build passed
